name: Autocomplete Field Match
description: Entity-reference autocomplete widget that also matches free-typed input against fields other than the entity label.
project_description: A module for those who need to allow free text in autocomplete fields that matches to a field on either the same entity or a field within a referenced entity. It ships one entity-reference field widget ('Autocomplete Field Match') and a companion 'autocomplete_field_match' form element that extends core's EntityAutocomplete. When an editor types a value and does NOT pick an item from the dropdown, the widget resolves the free text against one or more configured non-label fields (with a choice of comparison operator, langcodes, and AND/OR conjunction) instead of only the entity title, falling back to standard core autocomplete matching when an entity is selected. Field types available are Entity Reference, Field collection, or Paragraphs, though it may work on other referenced entities; it currently only matches to a referenced entity one level deep. Sponsored by University of Michigan Library.
